_comment: Blueprint: v7g WN arrival delay feature pipeline. Reads the enriched parquet and history pool written by blueprint_dep_v7g (step 1), and the departure features written by blueprint_dep_v7g (step 2). Run features_arr.py only — prepare_dataset.py does not need to be run again.

_workflow.prerequisite: Complete both steps of blueprint_dep_v7g.json first.

_path_note: All data paths use '../flightrightdata/data/...' (REPO_ROOT-relative) because features_arr.py resolves all paths against REPO_ROOT. These point to the same absolute files that blueprint_dep_v7g writes — e.g. '../flightrightdata/data/intermediate/WN_v7g_unbalanced.parquet' is the same file as 'data/intermediate/WN_v7g_unbalanced.parquet' in the dep blueprint (which uses DATA_ROOT-relative convention).
